audio.text: Can you show me how to use the new bike share app?

options: I usually walk to campus when it's sunny.
The app was free to download, I think.
Sure, open it and tap the map icon first.
I showed my photos to my family.

why.en: Request → agreement with help. A and D do not respond to the request (D repeats "show" in another sense); B gives information but not the help that was asked for.
why.tr: Rica → kabul ve yardım. A ve D ricaya cevap vermiyor (D "show" kelimesini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor); B bilgi veriyor ama istenen yardımı vermiyor.
why.es: Petición → aceptación y ayuda. A y D no responden a la petición (D repite "show" con otro sentido); B da información pero no la ayuda que se pidió.
